faq.sync.q: Is my data synced across devices?
faq.sync.a: Yes. Everything is stored securely on the server, so any device you sign in on shows the same data — including your theme and language.
faq.offline.a: The app opens offline. New transactions made offline are clearly marked “pending sync” and are only counted once the server confirms them — no duplicates, ever.
faq.security.a: Passwords are hashed with Argon2id, sessions use secure HttpOnly cookies, and you can add passkeys and two-step verification.
faq.reminders.a: When you add a return date, LifeTrack schedules reminders (in-app, email and push) based on your reminder schedule in Notifications settings.
faq.currency.a: Yes. Each account has its own currency; totals and reports are converted to your main currency using rates set by the administrator.
faq.install.q: How do I install the app?
faq.install.a: On Android/Chrome use “Install app”. On iPhone tap Share → “Add to Home Screen”.
